settings.heading: Product features
settings.content:
• Space-saving C-shaped design that slides close to sofas and beds without taking up much floor space.
  • Height adjustable from 45–80 cm for flexible use with different seating heights.
  • Compact tabletop size of 40 x 30 cm, suitable for laptops, books, drinks, and snacks.
  • Scratch-resistant surface designed for regular daily use.
  • Stable metal base and joint for improved balance during use.
  • Easy to assemble with a simple setup process.
  • Multi-purpose utility as a couch side table, bed tray, tea table, or work-from-sofa table.

settings.heading: Materials and care
settings.content:
• Top Material: Engineered wood / wood-finish tabletop with a scratch-resistant surface, based on the product styling shown and comparable listings.
  • Frame Material: Powder-coated / heavy-duty metal frame and base for strength and durability.
  • Care Instructions: Wipe clean with a soft dry or lightly damp cloth; do not use abrasive cleaners or harsh chemicals; keep away from excess moisture.
  • Usage Care: Avoid overloading the tabletop, and tighten fittings periodically if needed to maintain stability.
  • Floor Protection: Lift when moving instead of dragging to avoid floor scratches.
